title: Polygon Rectangles
description: Find largest axis-aligned rectangles from polygon vertices.
writeup:
## Approach

Given a polygon defined by vertices, find the largest axis-aligned rectangle using pairs of vertices as opposite corners.

## Part 1

For every pair of vertices, compute the rectangle area `(|x1-x2|+1) * (|y1-y2|+1)`. Take the maximum.

## Part 2

Now the rectangle must be fully contained inside the polygon. For each candidate rectangle, verify containment: all four corners must be inside the polygon (ray-casting test), and no polygon edge may cross through the rectangle interior (segment intersection tests). Take the largest valid rectangle.
